writeup: TIC 308802946 is a candidate eclipsing binary star identified through automated analysis of TESS photometry. The system shows a primary eclipse with a depth of 4.89% and an orbital period of 1.7653 days, producing a strong detection signal of 57.3 in the BLS (Box Least Squares) search. Pixel-level image analysis confirms the signal originates near the target location, with a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 12.6, though the centroid offset of 1.4 arcsec warrants consideration. No secondary eclipse was detected. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously uncatalogued source. The pipeline's machine-learning classifier assigned it a score of 0.21, and it passed all automated data quality checks without flags.
